objective: Use only ordinary retail shots to align a naturally hosted proximity bomb with a later fruit cycle when the current fruit is provably unreachable within the shared remaining lifetime budget.

cycle_alignment_contract.applies_when: fruit_policy bomb, fruit active and not collecting, at least one active type-0 bomb, and no c174 strict-radius trigger recommendation is available
cycle_alignment_contract.required_forward_waypoints: minimum nonnegative distance from bomb curve_distance to the start of a current point strict interval; zero inside an interval; no forward interval means infinity
cycle_alignment_contract.reachable_current_cycle: at least one bomb has required_forward_waypoints <= forward_waypoint_budget
cycle_alignment_contract.reachable_action: retain the qualified c176 bomb-preservation behavior unchanged
cycle_alignment_contract.unreachable_action: ordinary left-click projectile shot at the current rendered fruit target, reason defer_fruit_for_bomb_alignment
cycle_alignment_contract.unreachable_action_purpose: clear the current fruit so the naturally retained bomb can continue along the curve toward a later naturally scheduled fruit cycle

priority_order: existing c176 behavior outside the alignment condition

required_tests: c179a4-like waypoint 417 with 700 shared ticks defers current fruit
waypoint 800 with 700 shared ticks remains preservable for point 1
bomb already inside point 1 strict interval remains preservable
bomb beyond point 1 interval is unreachable by forward advance
strict Euclidean overlap still triggers before cycle alignment
inactive or collecting fruit retains c176 behavior
fruit expiry and bomb lifetime fields are decoded and validated
telemetry includes the new timing and waypoint fields
